Coram : UDAY UMESH LALIT*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
Service Law: Dismissal of respondent-employee on three charges of misconduct in performance of official duties – Appellate authority dismissed the appeal of respondent – Single judge of High Court allowed the writ petition and remanded the case to the appellate authority for fresh appellate authority affirmed the dismissal order – Respondent again filed writ petition – Single judge of High Court held that charge no.2 was not proved and without expressing any opinion on charge no.1 and 3 again remanded the matter to appellate authority for rehearing on charge
Decision Date : 03-10-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 10180/2018 | Disposal Nature : Leave Granted & Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
